description: Photograph of Georgia O'Keeffe on a boat during her first visit to Lake George with other students of the Art Students' League. An unknown man sits next to her. Photograph includes an envelope with typed text: "envelope #1//first trip to Lake George//5 pix of OKeeffe [sic]//1 (on lake) with students of Art Students League (NY)//1 on bench, sun-dappled, (1915?)//3 of Georgia by trees by the lake, age about 20;" and handwritten in O'Keeffe's hand: "Lake George from League."
title: Georgia O'Keeffe at Lake George
